integrity: Analytic finite EPPF identity, fixed factorial moments, conditional union bounds and moment method; standard-library exact-rational checker completed 45 assertions. Finite checks are not a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Concentration scaling theta/sqrt(n) to a strictly positive finite constant; no fluctuation theorem for the full meet; no sharp error for disappearance of common non-singleton blocks; historical priority qualified by possible general Poisson-approximation treatments.
title: A square-root Ewens coincidence law: Poisson-stable singletons amid extensive pair overlap
